detail.longDescription:
Muze is a personal agent for errands that take more than one step. Tell it what you need in plain words, then put your phone away. Muze keeps working in the background and lets you know when it needs you.

RESEARCH THAT SHOWS ITS WORK
Compare venues, products, or options. Muze reads the web, organizes what it finds into reports and tables, and links every source. It tells you what it couldn't verify. Export any report as a PDF.

SET IT ONCE
Have Muze check something every morning, on weekdays, or every few hours, and hear from it only when something changes. Ask for a reminder in plain words, like "remind me Friday at 5 to call Mom," and it pings you right on time.

PLACES, ROUTES, AND WEATHER
Ask what's open near you, how long the drive takes, what the weekend forecast looks like, or which flights fit your dates. If you allow location, Muze uses your approximate location only for questions about places nearby.

WORKS WITH YOUR APPS
Connect Notion, Todoist, Linear, Jira and Confluence, Canva, or Calendly in Me → Connected apps. Muze looks things up there on its own, and asks you before it adds or changes anything.

REMEMBERS WHAT MATTERS
Tell Muze your city, your diet, or how you like results, and it uses that in every chat and task. See, edit, or turn off memory anytime in Me.

YOUR OWN MUZE ADDRESS
Pick a username and get a matching email address. Muze can draft emails from it and wait for replies, for days if needed, then pick the task back up when the answer arrives.

YOU DECIDE WHO HEARS FROM YOU
Muze only writes to people you've allowed. Ask it to email someone on your list and it just sends; anyone else, you review, edit, and approve each message first.

FILES, HANDLED
Attach a file and ask Muze to convert it, pull out the data, or turn it into something new. Results land in your Library, ready to open or share.

CALM BY DESIGN
See what's waiting for you, what's in progress, what's scheduled, and what's done. Chats, tasks, and Library items stay until you delete them; files clear after 30 days unless you keep them.

Muze uses AI and can make mistakes. Check important details before you rely on them.
